mechanism: EPO shrinkage-covariance weights over a 10-ETF low-correlation pool
evidence: g.etf_pool = 10 cross-asset ETFs (159985 豆粕, 518800/159930 黄金, 513000 日经, 513100 纳指, 513030 德国, 159981 原油, 159980 有色, 510880 红利, 510230 金融) (l.18). epo() implements the Enhanced Portfolio Optimization shrinkage: shrunk_cor=((1-w)*I@corr)+(w*I), cov_tilde=std@shrunk_cor@std, epo=(1/lambda)*inv_shrunk_cov@signal with lambda_=10, w=0.6, negative weights clipped and renormalized (l.22-52). run_optimization uses 250 daily closes to previous_date and an inverse-variance signal a=(1/d)/(1/d).sum() (l.55-62). trade() then order_target_value(s, total_value*weights[s]) for every pool member (l.65-72); filter_new_stock drops names listed <30 days (l.74-76).
